pillars.title: Unity over division
pillars.principle: Build trust across counties by reducing polarization language and centering shared election-process confidence.

pillars.title: People organize their own communities
pillars.principle: Sustainable county operations are built by local captains, neighbors, and trusted institutions, not outside scripts.

pillars.title: Eye-to-eye campaigning
pillars.principle: Visible in-person presence and direct conversations are core credibility signals in Arkansas county politics.

pillars.title: Secretary of State is a balls-and-strikes office
pillars.principle: Election administration should be lawful, transparent, and non-cultural-war focused.

operatingMaxims: Old-school grassroots trust beats performative digital-only politics.
Volunteer ladders and phone trees scale small teams safely.
Use fairs, festivals, courthouse, and civic spaces for visibility.
No final strategy activation without human approval.
